title: Law concerning the Kingdom and the King's Duties
description: Moses gives instructions on how Israel is to choose a king when they settle in the land. The king must be one of their own brothers, chosen by the Lord. He must not acquire many horses, many wives, or large amounts of silver and gold, so that his heart is not led astray. The king shall write a copy of the law for himself and read from it all the days of his life, so that he learns to fear the Lord and does not exalt himself above his brothers.
